evals.prompt: Turn on the kitchen and living room lights to 75% brightness
evals.expected_output: Both rooms turn on with 75% brightness, command returns success status

evals.prompt: Set the eatery to a warm color at 40% brightness with a 2 second transition
evals.expected_output: Eatery lights adjust to warm temperature, 40% brightness, with smooth 2-second transition

evals.prompt: Check what lights are currently on, then turn off only the kitchen ones
evals.expected_output: Lists current state of all lights, then turns off kitchen lights only

evals.prompt: I want to control the three kitchen spots - set spot 1 to 30%, spot 2 to 60%, and spot 3 to 90%
evals.expected_output: Each kitchen spot set to its specified brightness level individually

evals.prompt: Turn off the driveway, garden, and office lights
evals.expected_output: All three rooms turn off, command returns success
